study_title: Saffron Extract Supplementation and Sleep Quality in Middle-Aged Adults
candidate_summary: This study looks at saffron extract supplementation and sleep quality in adults. To take part, you must be 18 to 65, have mild-to-moderate sleep disturbances, and meet the other listed requirements. The study also lists health conditions, treatments, and other factors that may prevent someone from joining.

criteria.requirement: You must be 18 to 65 years old.
criteria.screening_question: Are you between 18 and 65 years old?
criteria.satisfied_when: You are within the stated age range.
criteria.unclear_when: Your age cannot be confirmed or the information provided is inconsistent.

criteria.requirement: You must have mild-to-moderate sleep disturbances.
criteria.screening_question: Do you have mild-to-moderate sleep disturbances?
criteria.satisfied_when: An assessment confirms that your sleep disturbances are mild to moderate.
criteria.unclear_when: The severity of your sleep disturbances has not been assessed or is uncertain.

criteria.requirement: Your BMI must be between 18 and 35 kg/m².
criteria.screening_question: Is your BMI between 18 and 35 kg/m²?
criteria.satisfied_when: A BMI measurement confirms that it is within the stated range.
criteria.unclear_when: A BMI measurement is unavailable, or it is unclear whether a value at a range boundary qualifies.

criteria.original_text: Not receiving active pharmacological or psychological treatment for sleep disorders
criteria.requirement: You must not be receiving active pharmacological or psychological treatment for sleep disorders.
criteria.screening_question: Are you currently receiving medication-based or psychological treatment for a sleep disorder?
criteria.satisfied_when: You are not receiving either type of active treatment for a sleep disorder.
criteria.unclear_when: Your current treatment status or whether a treatment is active is uncertain.

criteria.original_text: Willingness to comply with study procedures
criteria.requirement: You must be willing to comply with study procedures.
criteria.screening_question: Are you willing to follow the study procedures?
criteria.satisfied_when: You confirm that you are willing to follow the study procedures.
criteria.unclear_when: You have not yet confirmed your willingness to follow the procedures.

criteria.original_text: Severe neurological, psychiatric, or cardiovascular disorders
criteria.requirement: You must NOT have severe neurological, psychiatric, or cardiovascular disorders.
criteria.screening_question: Do you have a severe neurological, psychiatric, or cardiovascular disorder?
criteria.satisfied_when: You do not have any of the listed severe disorders.
criteria.unclear_when: It is uncertain whether you have one of these disorders or whether it is severe.

criteria.original_text: Diagnosed with obstructive sleep apnea, treated with CPAP
criteria.requirement: You must NOT be diagnosed with obstructive sleep apnea and treated with CPAP.
criteria.screening_question: Have you been diagnosed with obstructive sleep apnea and treated with CPAP?
criteria.satisfied_when: You do not meet both conditions: an obstructive sleep apnea diagnosis and treatment with CPAP.
criteria.unclear_when: Your diagnosis or CPAP treatment status is uncertain.

criteria.requirement: You must NOT be a night shift worker.
criteria.satisfied_when: You do not work night shifts.
criteria.unclear_when: Your work schedule or whether it counts as night-shift work is uncertain.

criteria.original_text: Use of medications or supplements affecting sleep
criteria.requirement: You must NOT use medications or supplements that affect sleep.
criteria.screening_question: Do you use any medications or supplements that affect sleep?
criteria.satisfied_when: You do not use medications or supplements that affect sleep.
criteria.unclear_when: The effect on sleep of a medication or supplement you use is uncertain.

criteria.requirement: You must NOT use recreational drugs.
criteria.satisfied_when: You do not use recreational drugs.
criteria.unclear_when: Your recreational drug use status is not known or is uncertain.

criteria.requirement: You must NOT be pregnant or breastfeeding.
criteria.satisfied_when: You are neither pregnant nor breastfeeding.
criteria.unclear_when: Your pregnancy or breastfeeding status is uncertain.

criteria.requirement: You must NOT have uncontrolled medical conditions.
criteria.screening_question: Do you have any uncontrolled medical conditions?
criteria.satisfied_when: You do not have any uncontrolled medical conditions.
criteria.unclear_when: It is uncertain whether a medical condition is present or controlled.
